findings.text: The company was incorporated on 24 September 2014 and is 12.1 years old.
The confirmation statement is overdue; it is next due 23 October 2026 and was last made up to 9 October 2025.
Accounts are not overdue; they were last made up to 31 March 2025 and are next due 31 December 2026.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for the company.
There are 3 current officers: 2 directors, PERSON 350 (appointed 25 September 2014) and PERSON 351 (appointed 1 October 2015), and 1 other officer.
Two current persons with significant control are recorded: PERSON 353 (individual; ownership of shares 50 to 75 percent) and PERSON 354 (individual; ownership of shares 25 to 50 percent).
No charges are registered against the company.
Across the 2 current directors checked, 4 other companies were found (2 active, 2 dissolved); this may be incomplete because appointments are matched by officer ID.
No registered office address changes and no officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 462 is an active company with no insolvency record, but its confirmation statement is overdue.
